parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain the main principles behind the use of ultrasound to obtain diagnostic information
about internal body structures.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The fraction of the incident intensity of an ultrasound beam that is reflected at a boundary
between two media depends on the specific acoustic impedances $Z_{1}$ and $Z_{2}$ of the
media.
Discuss qualitatively how the relative magnitudes of the two specific acoustic impedances
affect the reflected intensity.
